is: The price table, the Claude Code transcript parser and the golden-file fixtures behind `zaf report`, which ports tools/burn.py.
conventions: Rendered text must reproduce burn.py's output exactly, checked against fixtures/*.expected.txt

fs.name: fixtures/
fs.role: Claude projects tree plus burn.py golden outputs

fs.name: transcript.rs
fs.role: one *.jsonl to one Run, turns deduped by message id

notes: tools/burn.py is not tracked in this repo (retired 2026-10-28, in git history); the golden files are its output for `--root fixtures/projects --hours 100000`, run once
fixtures/projects/-demo mirrors a Claude config dir's projects/ layout, including a session's subagents/ folder
burn.match-plan.expected.txt is the output filtered to runs matching `Plan`
Dollar figures weigh runs against the weekly limit; compare shares, not decimals
